usage: Most often means a school teacher. It is a very common everyday word in Hong Kong Cantonese.
Use it for both male and female teachers; there is no gender change in the word itself.
It can also be used respectfully when speaking to or about someone who teaches a class or course.
Commonly appears with school, class, subject, and student-related words in daily conversation.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 baan1 go3 lou5si1 hou2 hou2 jan4
examples.meaning: Our class teacher is very nice.

examples.jyutping: lou5si1 gam1 jat6 gaau3 ngo5 dei6 se2 zi6
